tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Find ibiPoint eSIM plans for one destination or several (countries or regions, any language). Returns the best-value plans first with full facts, coverage lists and a direct link; multi-country plans that include the destination are returned too and marked covers_via. Use when a user wants mobile da

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Full facts for one ibiPoint plan by product id: coverage with networks per country, data and speed rules, activation and validity rules, top-up, tethering, price with basis (per-day plans: price_30_days and price_max), reviews and link — quoted in the customer's bucket or currency when given.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Hand the customer to the ibiPoint shop to buy one plan. Returns buy_url (the product page where they tap Buy now and pay securely — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Amazon Pay, Klarna or a local method such as iDEAL | Wero, Bancontact, BLIK or Pix, with an optional discount code) plus the plan n

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Turn a trip into up to three plan recommendations: countries (1-5, any language), number of days and how much data the traveller uses. Each fit carries the full plan facts, the total price for the whole trip and a one-sentence reason built only from catalogue facts. Use this first whenever the user

tools.name: get_shop_facts
tools.description: How ibiPoint works, in the shop's own words: delivery and installation, device requirements, payment methods, money-back guarantee, top-up, hotspot, support and company details. Use for any "how / when / what if" question that is not about one specific plan.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_esim_plans" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
